title: Isolation and Transfection of Protoplasts From Maize Mesophyll Cells
author: Lauren A. Higa
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML
materials: TZI8 maize seeds (Maize Genetics Corporation Stock Center, TZI
Ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid, disodium salt dihydrate (EDTA) (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: S311-
Polyethylene glycol 4,000 (PEG 4000) (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: AAA
RNase A solution (Fisher Scientific, catalog number: PR-A
Trypan Blue solution, 0.4% (Fisher Scientific, catalog number:

steps.title: Prepare Protoplast Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 48.75 mL D‑mannitol (0.6 M, final 585 mM), 0.25 mL KCl (2 M, final 10 mM) and 1.0 mL MES (0.5 M, pH 5.7, final 10 mM) to a 50 mL Falcon tube, mix gently by inversion at room temperature. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare MMG Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 33.0 mL D‑mannitol (0.6 M, final 40 mM), 400 µL MES (0.5 M, final 4 mM), 750 µL MgCl₂ (1 M, final 15 mM) and sterile ddH₂O to a final volume of 15.5 mL in a 50 mL Falcon tube, mix gently by inversion avoiding bubbles at room temperature. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare W5 Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 6.25 mL CaCl₂ (1 M, final 125 mM), 125 µL KCl (2 M, final 5 mM), 40 µL MES (0.5 M, pH 5.7, final 0.5 mM), 77 µL NaCl (1 M, final 1.54 mM) and sterile ddH₂O to a final volume of 43.5 mL in a 50 mL Falcon tube, mix gently by inversion at room temperature. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare WI Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 41.67 mL D‑mannitol (0.6 M, final 500 mM), 400 µL MES (0.5 M, final 4 mM), 100 µL KCl (2 M, final 4 mM) and sterile ddH₂O to a final volume of 7.83 mL in a 50 mL Falcon tube, mix gently by inversion at room temperature. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare PEG Solution
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL CaCl₂ (1 M, final 100 mM), 3.0 mL D‑mannitol (1 M, final 600 mM), 2.0 g PEG 4000 (40 % w/v) and sterile ddH₂O to a total volume of 5.0 mL in a 15 mL Falcon tube. Place the tube in a 55 °C water bath until the PEG is completely dissolved. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Add 2.0 g CTAB (2 % w/v), 4.0 mL 0.5 M EDTA (pH 8.0, final 20 mM), 8.2 g NaCl (1.40 M) and sterile ddH₂O to a final volume of 100 mL in a 100 mL Falcon tube, then add Tris‑HCl (1 M, pH 8.0) to reach 100 mM final concentration. Mix by inversion at room temperature until completely dissolved. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare Enzyme Suspension
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL Falcon tube add 300 mg cellulase (2.9 % w/v), 70 mg macerozyme (0.69 % w/v) and 10 mL protoplast buffer (Recipe 1). Incubate at 55 °C for 5 min, inverting halfway through. Cool on ice for 5 min, then warm to room temperature for 5 min. Add 50 µL CaCl₂ (1 M, final 4.93 mM) and 100 µL BSA (10 %, final 0.0985 % w/v), mix by inversion. This suspension is sufficient for 1–2 g fresh leaf tissue. Prepare on the day of the experiment, do not save leftover, store at room temperature and use within 24 h.

steps.title: Germinate Maize Seeds
steps.instruction: Place TZI8 seeds between wet paper towels in a closed container and incubate at room temperature for 3 days.

steps.title: Establish Seedlings
steps.instruction: Transfer germinated seeds to wet soil (1–2 seeds per pot) and grow under a 16‑h photoperiod for 3 days.

steps.title: Etiolate Seedlings
steps.instruction: Turn off lights and grow seedlings in complete darkness for 8 days. Water sparingly; overwatering can harm the plants.

steps.title: Harvest Second Leaves
steps.instruction: Using a new clean razor blade, cut off the second leaf of each seedling at the base and discard the top and bottom quarters of each leaf.

steps.title: Slice Leaf Strips
steps.instruction: Cut the remaining leaf material into 2–3 cm pieces, then slice very thin strips (<1–2 mm) along the leaf veins.

steps.title: Enzyme Infiltration
steps.instruction: Place leaf strips in a flask equipped with a vacuum arm. Gently add the enzyme suspension, swirl to submerge, and vacuum infiltrate for 1 min, twice, swirling between infiltrations.

steps.title: Digest Tissue
steps.instruction: Cover the flask with aluminum foil and shake at 60 rpm for 3.5 h at room temperature in the dark.

steps.title: Release Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Increase shaking to 90 rpm for 5 min to release protoplasts from the tissue.

steps.title: Filter Protoplast Suspension
steps.instruction: Pour the enzyme suspension containing protoplasts into a 50 mL Falcon tube through a 70 µm nylon mesh, letting the liquid run down the side of the tube gently.

steps.title: First Centrifugation Wash
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtrate at 200 × g for 2 min at room temperature. Aspirate the supernatant, leaving a small volume of wash buffer to avoid disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Second Wash with Protoplast Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 mL protoplast buffer, centrifuge again at 200 × g for 2 min, aspirate supernatant, and repeat the wash once more.

steps.title: Resuspend in MMG Buffer
steps.instruction: After the final wash, resuspend the protoplast pellet in 3 mL MMG buffer.

steps.title: Count and Viability Test
steps.instruction: Count protoplasts with a hemocytometer and assess viability using 0.4 % Trypan Blue.

steps.title: Adjust Protoplast Concentration
steps.instruction: Dilute the suspension to 5 × 10⁵ cells mL⁻¹ with MMG buffer.

steps.title: Mix DNA with Protoplasts
steps.instruction: In a 2‑mL tube combine 20 µL plasmid DNA (10 µg) with 100 µL protoplast suspension.

steps.title: Add PEG Solution
steps.instruction: Add 120 µL PEG solution (equal volume to DNA‑protoplast mix) and gently invert twice to mix.

steps.title: Incubate Transfection Mix
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 15 min.

steps.title: Stop Reaction with W5
steps.instruction: Add 480 µL W5 buffer to the incubation mixture.

steps.title: Pellet Transfected Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 200 × g for 2 min, then remove supernatant by pipetting (view pellet against a dark background if needed).

steps.title: Wash with WI Buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet 1–2 times with 480 µL WI buffer, centrifuging at 200 × g for 2 min each time and removing supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Final Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 200 µL WI buffer.

steps.title: Prepare 12‑Well Plate
steps.instruction: Add 800 µL WI buffer to each well of a sterile 12‑well plate.

steps.title: Seed Protoplasts in Plate
steps.instruction: Transfer the 200 µL protoplast suspension into the corresponding wells containing 800 µL WI buffer.

steps.title: Incubate Transfected Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature in the dark overnight.

steps.title: Observe Fluorescence
steps.instruction: Approximately 16 h post‑transfection, detect mCherry signal at 600–650 nm using confocal or fluorescence microscopy.

steps.title: Collect Protoplast Pellets
steps.instruction: At 48 h post‑transfection, pool technical replicates into a 2‑mL tube, centrifuge at 3,000 × g for 2 min, and carefully aspirate the supernatant (repeat centrifugation if pooled volume exceeds 2 mL).

steps.title: Lyse Cells with CTAB
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL CTAB buffer to the pellet, vortex, and incubate at 60 °C for 45 min.

steps.title: Extract Aqueous Phase
steps.instruction: Vortex again, centrifuge at 17,000 × g for 10 min, and transfer the supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: RNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL RNase A (10 mg mL⁻¹) to the supernatant and incubate 20 min at 37 °C.

steps.title: Phenol‑Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL (1 volume) phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1), vortex ≥30 s, and centrifuge at 17,000 × g for 10 min in a fume hood. Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube; discard the lower phase.

steps.title: Repeat Phenol‑Chloroform
steps.instruction: Repeat the phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction with the recovered aqueous phase.

steps.title: Final Chloroform Wash
steps.instruction: Repeat extraction using only chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (no phenol) on the aqueous phase.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with Isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 0.7 volumes ice‑cold isopropanol to the aqueous phase, vortex briefly, and incubate at –20 °C overnight (minimum 3 h).

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 min at 4 °C, remove supernatant, and keep the pellet on ice.

steps.title: Ethanol Washes
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge at maximum speed for 15 min at 4 °C, and remove supernatant. Repeat the ethanol wash once more.

steps.title: Final Ethanol Removal
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 min at 4 °C, then use a 10‑20 µL pipette tip to remove any remaining ethanol without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Dry and Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet at room temperature for 15 min (avoid overdrying) and resuspend in 20 µL RNase‑free water.

steps.title: Prepare Libraries for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Design PCR amplicons of ~300–500 bp (for 2 × 300 bp paired‑end reads) with the expected edit near the centre, then submit the purified DNA for paired‑end sequencing.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol (or parts of it) has been used and validated in the following research article(s): Higa et al. [2025]. Rapid assessment of CRISPR gRNAs with optimized protoplast transformation in maize. Plant Cell Reports.
